externalBaseline.publicationPolicy: Every resource is catalogue-visible. Full text is exposed only where a locally ready asset and a verified public-domain/open-license basis permit public redistribution. Metadata publication does not imply binary redistribution rights.
externalBaseline.note: All 730 resource records are now committed to the public catalogue dataset. The 715 non-full-text records remain visible with their actual access state rather than being omitted or represented by fake reader/listen/watch capabilities.
externalBaseline.sourceFirstPolicy: EPUB > TXT > DOCX/DOC > ODT/RTF > HTML/MD/XML > embedded-text PDF > OCR
